results.title: time - How to benchmark programs in Rust? - Stack Overflow
results.snippet: A quick way to find out the execution time of a program, regardless of implementation language, is to run time prog on the command line. For example: Copy~$ time sleep 4 real 0m4.002s user 0m0.000s sys 0m0.000s · The most interesting measurement is usually user, which measures the actual amount of work done by the program, regardless of what's going on in the system (sleep is a pretty boring program to benchmark).
